_status: CREATED in Shopify on 2026-09-25. IDs are in catalog/store-setup.json. Change definitions only via the Shopify MCP GraphQL workflow. On 2026-09-27: the storefront-filter definitions (team_handle, league_handle, styles, player; admin-filterable, like audience and kit), the audience choice "women" and the shop metafield filter_names (catalog/README.md, "מסננים באתר").

fields.note: {"rows": [...]} (or a bare array). Row keys, all optional but size: size, age, height_cm, weight_kg, chest_width_cm (flat, armpit to armpit), chest_cm (circumference), length_cm, shorts_length_cm. Values are numbers or ranges such as "160-170". Other keys are kept but not shown.

product_metafields.note: set pieces: a basketball jersey <-> the shorts of the same kit (same design on the photos), both directions; product page and cart 'complete the set'
storefront filter 'קבוצה': the team slug (= its collection handle), mirrored from the team: tag
storefront filter 'ליגה': the league slug, mirrored from the league: tag
storefront filter 'סגנון', mirrored from the style: tags
storefront filter 'שחקן': player slugs, mirrored from the player: tags

shop_metafields.note: he/en/ar names of the filter values, written by scripts/catalog/filter-data.mjs from catalog/taxonomy.json; read by snippets/facet-label.liquid

the set price the theme shows: { discount_amount (₪ off the shorts), discount_title, jersey_tag, shorts_tag }; must match the automatic discount 'מחיר סט: גופייה + מכנסיים' (catalog/pricing.json, sets); read by snippets/set-price.liquid and snippets/cart-items.liquid

collection_metafields._note: Collection metafields (namespace sportwear). banner created 2026-09-27; card_image, card_color and card_mark created 2026-09-28.

banner.name: באנר
banner.use: The wide picture at the top of the collection page and in the empty cart's category tiles (design/imagery/README.md, 'Brand graphics'). Set on 32 collections on 2026-09-27; which picture where: design/imagery/brand-prompts.json, collection_banners.

card_image.name: Card picture
card_image.use: A cut-out jersey on a transparent background for the collection's collector card (sections/collection-circles.liquid: the players and teams rows on the home page and the 404 page). Set on 34 collections on 2026-09-28 (design/imagery/collector-cards.json); made with scripts/images/cutout.py from the collection's studio photo.

card_color.name: Card color
card_color.use: The color that lights the collector card (a glow on a dark card). Picked per card for the team's identity and for contrast with the jersey; neighbours in a row differ.

card_mark.name: Card number
card_mark.use: The giant outlined number or code behind the jersey: a player's number (24) or a team's short code (RMA).
